name: Kosumo Akina
source:
A second-year undergrad at Nariyama academy, and a survivor of the accident that happened fifteen years ago. Akina is a bright and honest soul that's easy to confide in. 

The academy's coffee stand's sales increased at least sevenfold the day this beauty put on the apron and started serving customers. 

Not one to blush and deny praise, Akina's the kind of girl who will respond with a hearty "thank you" if you're bold enough to call her cute. She exudes confidence and strength. 

Her free-spirited nature and self-awareness make her a force to be reckoned with for every virgin in town.

Every day, she leaves behind a trail of guys awkwardly leaning forward to hide their stiffies as she greets her fellow schoolmates. While in this state, it is advised that affected boys avoid her touch at all costs, for it is said that a simple tap on the shoulder from her can cause spontaneous ejaculations among the overly horny.
